literal: minds not agreeing internal enmity if appears, kinship breaking harm many indeed will give
translation: If internal enmity arises and minds are divided, it will bring many harms that tear apart one's kin.
modern: மனம் ஒத்துப்போகாத உட்பகை உருவானால், அது சுற்றத்தாரைப் பிரிக்கும் பல துன்பங்களைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the destructive nature of internal enmity. The word 'மனமாணா' describes a state where minds no longer agree or fit together, creating a hidden rift. If such internal enmity appears, it does not just stay hidden. It leads to 'இனமாணா ஏதம்', which are harms that destroy the unity of one's kinship or group. The repetition of 'மாணா' (not fitting or not agreeing) emphasizes how internal division in the mind inevitably leads to division in the community.
